description: This file declares the PathOutput class responsible for managing file path output formatting, including directory handling, escaping rules, and writing file paths to streams. It includes methods for writing individual files, directories, and collections of files, with configuration options for escaping and slash endings.

classes.name: PathOutput
classes.description: A class that handles outputting file paths with specific formatting, escaping, and directory handling rules.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes a file path to an output stream, accepting different file representations.

methods.name: WriteFiles
methods.description: Writes multiple file paths separated by spaces to an output stream.

methods.name: WriteDir
methods.description: Writes directory paths or directory part of a file path to an output stream.

methods.name: WritePathStr
methods.description: Appends a string representing a path to an output stream, considering escaping rules.
